en: Spin easy on the ride out: the practice band shows your cadence target
Pick a spot with left and right, or let the highlight scan and surge to cast
In a fight, cadence steers the line: too slow fills strain, too fast fills slack
Gulls, sonar marks and foam lines show where fish gather: more means a stronger spot
When a fish runs, the pull rises for a while: hold the band and it tires
Sprint hard in the first 15 s of a Landing to fill the gaff meter for a Trophy
Strike! Confirm or surge to set the hook
Snap! The line broke. Another fish is coming
Thrown hook! The fish shook loose. Another fish is coming
Missed it! It will bite again soon
Double Hookup! Fights that overlap score more
Frenzy! The fish are biting all round
The fish runs! Hold the band
It jumps! Keep the line tight
Lines in, time to head home
